basics.name: Samuel Antoine Rémi Duval
basics.label: Software Engineer | C++ Systems | AI Optimization | Parallel Computing
basics.summary: Software engineer with 7 years of experience in compiler and systems programming and AI software development, expert in C++ optimization and AI frameworks. Key achievements include reducing an automotive Android service’s boot time from 52 seconds to 13 seconds and building a C++17 document intelligence engine that achieved a 50% speed improvement and 20% lower character error rate. Seeking a Compiler Engineer position at Nexalis, where my compiler and AI development skills can support the mission of bringing breakthrough neuromorphic technology into real-world deployment.

highlights: Containerized local AI coding agent with Podman and Docker, hardening the setup with user isolation and security best practices
Helped set up local LLM infrastructure for internal development workflows, enabling private, on-premise AI assistance
Technical lead of the team building a React / TypeScript IFE app for constrained inflight hardware

work.name: LUMEN FIELD GmbH
work.summary: Android-based automotive infotainment platform developed for Velora. Established technical documentation and collaborated with cross-functional teams to define architecture and drive implementation standards for Android HMI applications.
